state: Unpublished contract definition; C# fixture validation is development-only
optionalFields: Omit unavailable resource and top-level fields. No null optional fields. Attribute null is explicit and preserved. Empty attributes and empty message/template are valid.
text: Valid Unicode scalar sequences only; no unpaired UTF-16 surrogates. Reject Unicode category Control in identities, event/component names, attribute keys and operation IDs. Names/keys must not be empty. Preserve message/template text verbatim. Trim optional identifiers; blanks become absent.
timestamp: UTC invariant yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.fffffff'Z'; convert offset instants to UTC before encoding. Reject impossible calendar dates.
uuid: Lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal D form. A UUID attribute is a string; construction is explicit.

integer.input: Canonical signed base-10 string in portable constructor fixtures, parsed exactly; C# API accepts long.

decimal-string.detail: Explicit invariant non-exponent decimal text; preserve fractional precision/trailing zeros. Decimal whole values use .0; never automatically converted from numbers.

number.input: Invariant floating-point text in portable fixtures; finite IEEE-754 double only. Integer-valued doubles remain the explicit number kind. Wire numbers alone cannot prove which constructor was chosen.

array.ownership: Recursively owned supported values; preserve order. Bounded projection records truncation instead of copying excessive children.

map.ownership: Ordinal, case-sensitive, unique string keys; recursively owned supported values with bounded traversal/truncation provenance.

values.unsupported: Reject arbitrary objects, reflection serialization, arbitrary ToString, cyclic inputs, non-finite numbers and unrecognized value kinds. A separately specified provider adapter may normalize supported runtime scalars.

accounting: Root attributes map is node 1 at depth 1. Each scalar/map/array adds one node; each containment edge adds one depth. Keys are not value nodes. Check while traversing/copying; truncate scope inputs and final merged payload independently, preserving provenance. Aggregate bytes count the entire actual UTF-8 JSON, escapes and one LF, with no BOM. Truncate ordinary oversized payload before admission; never split records. An already serialized fixture above the configured cap is invalid output.

scope.merge: Outer to inner scope attributes, then event attributes; last ordinal key wins.
scope.operationId: Nonblank trimmed event ID overrides innermost nonblank scope ID; blank is absent.
scope.reserved: service/env/version/resource and operation_id/trace_id/span_id are never sourced from free-form attributes. Attribute keys with these spellings remain ordinary nested attributes; they cannot alter top-level fields.
scope.flow: Runtime instance and async execution-context isolation; child task context inheritance. LIFO disposal; repeat in owner flow harmless; out-of-order InvalidOperationException leaves state unchanged. No cross-concurrent-flow disposal.

activity: At event creation, use only a valid W3C Activity.Current trace/span pair: lowercase nonzero 32/16 hex IDs. Omit both otherwise. Scopes/attributes cannot override the pair.
exception: Capture type/message/stack and ordered AggregateException children at event creation; exclude Data and arbitrary properties. Preorder traversal retains at most 16 nodes at depth at most 4. Clip text at scalar boundaries. Mark truncated:true on every node whose own text or child content was omitted; omit false/absent markers. Required type/message retained. Re-check aggregate bytes after projection; truncate remaining ordinary payload if still too large; keep all retained exception node markers.
evolution: Producers emit only v1 projection fields. Readers ignore unknown optional fields, including inside resource/exception. Existing field names/types/meaning and schema version remain fixed. Member order is not contractual. No config/destination objects are projected by producers.
forwarding: Forwarded domain events preserve original producer metadata; a consumer-created log uses consumer metadata.
executionLimit: Contract validator and compile-only consumers do not implement event capture, scopes, exception clipping, output serialization/admission, other languages or collector ingestion.
authority: User requests during WP02-S02 override the supplied fixed/reject policy: default 64 KiB, environment override and truncation of oversized entries. Names and override range are maintainer prepublication choices.

oversize.protected: Preserve schema, severity, timestamp, event/component names, service/env/version, core build/instance/startup/resource identifiers, operation ID and trace/span IDs. Never split a record or silently change a value type.
oversize.payload: Oversized message/template/exception text is clipped at Unicode scalar boundaries. Attribute depth/node excess omits remaining children while retaining map/array shape. Cut UTF-8 strings safely; omit an entire integer-string/decimal-string/UUID/timestamp value rather than corrupting its representation.
oversize.marker: Top-level truncated:true is emitted only when event payload/context content was omitted. Exception nodes also retain their local truncated:true marker. Attribute keys called truncated cannot overwrite this marker.
oversize.order: First apply field/traversal bounds. Reserve protected envelope and top-level marker bytes. Retain payload in order: message, attributes in ordinal key order (arrays in input order), exception preorder, message_template, optional descriptive resource text. Allocate remaining bytes greedily in that order, including JSON escaping, delimiters and LF; omit optional payload fields/children that cannot fit. Required message and attributes remain valid, possibly empty. Omit empty optional template/exception only when truncating. Preserve ordinal keys and all retained value types.
oversize.traversal: Stop copying ordinary content at bounds; never create or queue the full oversized secondary representation, invoke arbitrary ToString or split the entry. Scope capture owns a bounded projection and carries truncation provenance into subsequent events.
oversize.minimumRationale: 16 KiB accommodates the maximum required v1 identities/correlation plus marker under minimal UTF-8 escaping. The selected 16 MiB maximum is a configurable resource ceiling, not a new default. Measure actual encoded size for every rendered output, including human escapes.
oversize.unrepresentableEnvelope: If the protected envelope cannot fit because of future projection extensions or extra escaping, report InvalidEvent with a specific envelope-too-large error; never emit an oversized/invalid record or alter identity. This is not the ordinary payload oversize path.
oversize.invalidInputs: Unsupported objects, invalid numeric representations, malformed Unicode, invalid identities/names/keys and scope misuse remain errors; they are not fixed by truncation.
oversize.execution: Truncation is specified here; real bounded capture/rendering execution belongs to WP04/WP05.
oversize.fileConsistency: When the file output is enabled, FileMaxBytes must be at least MaxEntryBytes. A smaller selected file segment bound is an OutOfRange issue for CORE_LOG_FILE_MAX_BYTES; do not fault later on an otherwise admitted large record. Disabled-file settings still validate individual bounds.
